title: Upscale Video Flow: test LTX 2.5 tile upscale, add LTX 2.5 + MiniMax H3 upscalers
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1267 - LTX 2.5 release. MERGED 2026-10-29 (Fabio): MPI-688 (H3 in the Upscale Video Flow) folded in. The Upscale Video Flow (ltx-upscale) gets two upscalers: LTX 2.5 tile upscale (Refine + Restore under tiled Native Resolution - bench it vs today's 2.3 Flow first) and the MiniMax H3 latent upscaler (already ships in our three H3 workflows - wire it in). Engine-bump block cleared (MPI-1095 done). Full scope, sources and traps: brief.md.
